city_hotel_low_floor.rationale: City Hotel Low months achieve blended ADR of $86.08 in v_monthly_kpis (unweighted $85.66); a strict $85.00 rate floor prevents margin-eroding flash discounting below direct marginal cost.

resort_hotel_low_floor.rationale: Resort Hotel Low months reach $50.36 in November and $53.44 in February; a $55.00 rate floor establishes a pricing baseline while relying on value-add inclusions rather than room-rate slashing.

test_t3_chisq.interpretation: Strong monotonic increase: cancellations scale 6-fold from 9.63% (0-7d) to 57.01% (181+d).

test_t4_mann_whitney.interpretation: Canceled bookings exhibit a median lead time 68.0 days longer than non-canceled stays.

scenario_181_plus_reduction_10pct.description: Tiered deposit and reconfirmation protocol reduces 181+ lead cancellations by 10%
scenario_181_plus_reduction_10pct.formula: avoided_cancellations = canceled_bookings * 0.10; preserved_room_nights = canceled_room_nights * 0.10; preserved_revenue = canceled_revenue * 0.10
scenario_181_plus_reduction_10pct.label: Scenario, not forecast
scenario_181_plus_reduction_10pct.caveat: Higher deposit requirements or rigid reconfirmation steps might deter price-sensitive long-lead bookers; the dataset cannot measure price or policy elasticity.

deposit_type.counter_intuitive_observation: Non-refundable deposits are designed to eliminate or deter cancellation by imposing financial forfeiture; an observed cancel rate of 99.36% is completely counter-intuitive.

investigative_hypotheses.name: Wholesale Group Block Option Dropping
investigative_hypotheses.description: Portuguese wholesale tour operators contracted room blocks under standard non-refundable rate codes but released unsold inventory back to the hotel prior to release cutoffs without financial penalty.

investigative_hypotheses.name: PMS Logging and Recording Artefact
investigative_hypotheses.description: Property management system integration may have defaulted cancelled wholesale reservations or uncollected deposits to a 'Non Refund' label upon status change to 'Canceled'.

investigative_hypotheses.name: Duplicate Booking / Re-booking Cycles
investigative_hypotheses.description: Tour operator software agents may have re-booked blocks multiple times, creating synthetic cancelled records (supported by the high duplicate rate in raw data).

scenario_non_refund_reform_10pct.description: Contractual and operational audit eliminates 10% of phantom Non Refund group block cancellations
scenario_non_refund_reform_10pct.formula: avoided_cancellations = total_non_ref_cancellations * 0.10; preserved_room_nights = total_non_ref_canceled_nights * 0.10; preserved_revenue = total_non_ref_canceled_revenue * 0.10
scenario_non_refund_reform_10pct.label: Scenario, not forecast
scenario_non_refund_reform_10pct.caveat: Hypothetical scenario based on administrative contract reform; does not imply realized cash collections if deposits were never collected.

scenario_late_cancellations_reduction_10.description: Reconfirmation protocol and 7-day cancellation window reduces late cancellations (<=7 days) by 10%
scenario_late_cancellations_reduction_10.formula: avoided_late_cancellations = total_late_cancellations * 0.10; covered_room_nights = total_late_room_nights * 0.10; covered_upper_bound_revenue = total_late_cancel_revenue_at_risk * 0.10
scenario_late_cancellations_reduction_10.label: Scenario, not forecast
scenario_late_cancellations_reduction_10.caveat: Revenue at risk represents an upper bound assuming all un-cancelled rooms would have been paid at full rate; it does not account for rooms resold before arrival or replacement bookings.

room_mismatch_scenario.description: 20% reduction in preventable room type reassignments via advance inventory blocking

mix_shift_scenario.description: Shift 2,000 room-nights from underperforming Groups segment to Direct segment at each hotel
mix_shift_scenario.label: Scenario, not forecast
mix_shift_scenario.caveat: Higher prices would probably reduce occupancy; the dataset cannot measure price elasticity. Mix shift assumes that sufficient unmet Direct demand exists at full BAR to replace wholesale group allotments.
